title: what does your bot do when the connection is fine but one feed goes quiet?
author: Alphanet_dogwalker
selftext:
Saw a thread where futures quotes kept arriving but trade prints stopped. thats a more awkward failure than a clean disconnect because a basic connection check can still look healthy.

say a bot uses both quotes and recent traded volume. if only the quote feed is alive, the last volume reading could keep getting reused as if nothing happened. I'd want the age of each input checked before a new entry. the harder bit is deciding when quiet means broken. a thin market going a minute without a trade is different from a liquid contract going silent during an active session.

What has actually worked for ppl running these systems? especially the rule for allowing entries again after data returns. one fresh message doesnt necessarily mean the missing history has been repaired

comments.author: ciaranwalsh96
comments.body:
I treat every dependency as its own state machine, not one connection flag. Each message gets an exchange timestamp, receive timestamp and sequence number. The entry gate requires every input to be fresh for that instrument/session and no sequence gap to be unresolved. If trades go stale while quotes remain live, freeze new entries immediately, keep risk-reducing exits available, and log the exact feed and age that tripped it.



I would not reopen on the first packet. Backfill from the last good sequence, replay the missing events, rebuild rolling features, reconcile positions with the broker, then require a short run of consecutive on-time messages or one complete bar before calling the feed healthy. If backfill is unavailable, reset the affected indicators and wait through their warm-up window.



For the timeout, use the instrument's observed interarrival distribution by session rather than one global number, with a hard ceiling for liquid markets. Then fault-test it by pausing only trades, dropping sequence ranges and replaying delayed packets; the test passes only if no entry uses stale state and recovery waits for a complete rebuild.
